item.title: Prince Andrew Joins UK Muslim Rape Gang So He Can Keep Abusing Young Girls
item.description: LONDON — In a stunning twist that experts said could prevent him from facing prosecution for ties to deceased billionaire Jeffrey Epstein, the former Prince Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor joined a UK Muslim rape gang so he could keep abusing young girls.

item.title: Desperate John Bolton Throws Stink Bomb Into Trump's Board Of Peace Meeting
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — With the fate of the Middle East hanging in the balance and concerns rising that war with Iran could be imminent, a desperate John Bolton was seen throwing a stink bomb into President Donald Trump's inaugural "Board of Peace" meeting.

item.title: In Historic First, Socialist Runs Out Of Money
item.description: NEW YORK, NY — Mayor Zohran Mamdani reported a projected $5.4 billion budget gap, marking the first time in recorded history that a socialist has ever run out of money.

item.title: Canadian Government Praised For Euthanizing Nickelback
item.description: OTTAWA — The international community had reportedly changed its tune on assisted suicide, even going so far as to openly praise Canada following an announcement by Prime Minister Mark Carney that they had successfully euthanized Nickelback.

item.title: Man Traces Lifelong Cocaine Addiction To Childhood Love Of Fun Dip
item.description: TORRANCE, CA — Jeremy Fales, a local marketer for a Fortune 500 company, reportedly had an epiphany on Thursday when he traced his lifelong cocaine addiction back to his childhood love of Fun Dip.

item.title: Joker Vows To Take Revenge On Gotham City After 13th-Place Finish At Winter Olympics
item.description: MILANO — One of the world's most infamous supervillains announced plans to unleash years of pent-up frustration on the innocent residents of an unsuspecting American city, as the Joker vowed to take revenge on Gotham City after finishing in 13th place in figure skating at the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics.
